title: Before you submit the practical
body: Review your artifacts and proceed to the required assessment or capstone submission.
wrap: Submit the fictional capstone pack. SCORM may record submission readiness, but a qualified human assessor must record the practical result before credential award.
footnote: Finishing this module records preparation as completed. It never records a pass. The accreditation needs every module quiz, the final exam, and a human-scored practical of at least 80/100 with all five critical gates passed.
